svg.title: Agilex 7 + TI AFE7950 DRA Architecture
svg.desc: Ku-band DRA using Altera Agilex 7 FPGAs and TI AFE7950 RF sampling RFICs over JESD204C, with separate RX and TX clusters.
svg.text: Ku-band uplink/downlink | JESD204C | Separate RX/TX silicon paths | Super-het for Ku RX

g.text: 8 x AFE7950 | 4 RX ADC ch each = 32 RX
3 GSPS RF-sampling ADC | integrated DDC / NCO / DSA
AFE: RF sample + DDC/NCO/DSA | FPGA: DBFN (4-color, 8-way) + UL channelizer (4x125 MHz/beam) + DVB-RCS2 / 3GPP-NTN Low-PHY

svg.text: HPS / soft Nios or hard processors on Agilex 7 for control-plane | Multi-device SYSREF + phase-sync for coherent beamforming
High-speed SerDes between Agilex 7 clusters and Feeder-link stage (e.g. 58 Gbps class links)

g.text: 10 x AFE7950 | 4 TX DAC ch each = 40 TX
12 GSPS RF DAC | DUC / NCO / TX DSA | up to 12 GHz RF
* DVB-S2X-only: park 2 AFEs (8 ch) or 4 ch on FPGA5 slot idle

svg.text: Per FPGA slot: 1x Agilex 7 + 2x AFE7950 (8 RF channels) | TX can direct-sample much of Ku DL; optional IF->Ku for 12.0-12.75 GHz edge
Totals: 9x Agilex 7 (5 TX + 4 RX) + 18x AFE7950 (10 TX + 8 RX) | Clean TX/RX isolation | Shared SYSREF / LO distribution for coherence
This split puts RF sampling in TI AFE7950 and digital beamforming/PHY in Agilex 7 - more BOM devices, standard JESD ecosystem, flexible RFIC selection (AFE7950 or AFE7950-SP).
Space path: AFE7950-SP + LMX2615-SP synthesizers + radiation-tolerant Agilex 7 grade where applicable.
Altera Agilex 7 + TI AFE7950 | Ku-band DRA Payload Architecture
